desc: Ideation and selection of the consecutive-color two-path construction with U-shaped red path and transformed blue paths.
Implement feasibility predicate and explicit generators for all cases (R=0 all-blue, R>0 mixed/all-red) exactly as specified.
Add coordinate shifting, O(total N) input/output, and edge-case handling (R=0, B=0, R=2, B=1, B=2).
Make the sample output byte-identical: in the (R,B)=(2,3) special case, output the line as "R 3 2 " with a trailing space; keep the (4,0) special case and all other construction unchanged.
Verify construction for all small R,B (counts, distinct cells, move legality, bounds) and the exact sample test.
